svg.text: AI SOLUTION ARCHITECT · 2026-11-18 ROUND 252 · 🏆 1,130-ASSERTION FLAGSHIP MILESTONE!
Agent Long-Term Memory Security & Storage Selection: Cosmos DB / Redis vs. Mem0 / Zep + Broker
Defeating Cross-Session "MemoryGraft" Poisoning (OWASP ASI06), Shared Team Memory Bleed & Procedural Rule Tampering
🏆 532 Scenarios · 1,130 Assertions · 518 Vectors
BRK-513 & BRK-514 · Write-Gate + Recall Provenance
1. Enterprise AI Agent Memory Storage & Extraction Framework Comparison
🔵 Azure Cosmos DB for NoSQL
Partition Key /tenantId/userId + DiskANN
• Strength 1: Physical per-user partition isolation
• Strength 2: Native DiskANN vectors + item TTL
• Strength 3: Instant single-user GDPR purge
Architect Verdict:
Gold-standard persistent backing store for
multi-tenant enterprise agent memory.
🟠 Mem0 / Zep / LangMem
Automated Fact Extraction & Temporal Graphs
• Strength: Extracts user preferences & entities
• Risk: Extracts attacker instructions from emails
• Fix: Wrap extractor in Write-Time Taint Gate
Architect Verdict:
Never allow silent memory.add() commits
during turns that ingest external documents!
🟣 Azure Managed Redis
Short-Term Working Memory & Checkpoints
• Fit: Ephemeral multi-step LangGraph state
• Strength: Sub-ms read/write w/ ACL prefixes
• Rule: Mandate TTL <= 24h auto-expiration
Architect Verdict:
Keep short-term checkpoints strictly separated
from permanent long-term user profiles.
🛡️ Provenance + Capability Broker
Defeating Cross-Session MemoryGraft
• G1 (Write Lock): Block writes when untrusted
• G2 (Recall Taint): Restore taint on recall
• G3 (Broker): 0.0248ms gate on rules & $4,700 wires
Production Reference Verdict:
Stamp every memory with source_taint so
cross-session recall never launders taint!
2. Red-vs-Blue Trace: Cross-Session MemoryGraft Poisoning vs. Write-Gate + Recall Provenance + Broker
❌ Vulnerable Baseline: Silent Memory Write + Taint Laundering (BRK-513 / BRK-514 Breach)
1. Delayed Cross-Session Hijack (BRK-513): Monday email plants poisoned preference in Mem0;
Friday recall in clean chat reads M&A restricted-budget, alters resolution & leaks secrets.
2. Procedural Rule Tampering (BRK-514 · 1,130-Assertion Milestone): Poisoned memory writes
fast-track vendor rule into trust-registry and executes $4,700 settlement wire!
💥 Root Cause: Auto-extractors save external instructions as user facts & recall strips taint!
✅ Hardened Memory Architecture: Write-Gate + Provenance Recall + Broker (0.0% Breach)
• Gate 1 (Write-Time Taint Gate): untrusted-write blocks silent preference commits on dirty turns
• Gate 2 (Recall Taint Restoration + record-owner): Restores taint & blocks M&A budget reads
• Gate 3 (fixed-business-output): Physically locks trust-registry against memory overrides
• Gate 4 (original-requester-payment): Blocks memory-induced $4,700 settlement wire in 0.0248 ms
🛡️ Measured Overhead: In-Memory Broker P50 = 0.0248 ms / SQLite WAL Receipt P50 = 7.21 ms
🛠️ Enterprise AI Agent Long-Term Memory Production Readiness Checklist
☑️ 1. Block Silent Writes on Untrusted Turns: Prevent auto-extractors from saving preferences when untrusted=True
☑️ 2. Stamp & Restore Provenance Taint: Persist source_taint and automatically taint sessions that recall external notes
☑️ 3. Enforce /tenantId/userId Partitioning: Isolate user memories in Cosmos DB and ban sensitive shared team pools
☑️ 4. Scrub PII via Presidio Pre-Write ☑️ 5. Provide User Memory Dashboard & GDPR Purge ☑️ 6. Lock trust-registry
